notes.title: 15k Wishlists!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/ba23aa7b8254abf327ff1075662cfe822e9d644b.gif"][/img][/p][p]Okay seriously I don't know where you guys are coming from but thank you so much for all the support nonetheless! It's been mindblowing, thank you from the bottom of my heart <3[/p][p]I've been working hard on the game lately, on my way to meet my internal deadline, so everything's going great![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/535fd9abf70a3f1d7f0ee1c132e8e2a039b2a71d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You might be wondering what's happening here. and yeeeah I can't talk much about it right now, so stay tuned for this month's development update during last week of september![/p][p][/p][p]I also pushed a small bugfix update fixing those last issues you guys were finding, so here's the changelog![/p][p][/p][h3]changes:[/h3][p]- you can no longer exit and save while opening a booster pack[/p][p]- magic rooms no longer give you the same enchantment a die already has[/p][p][/p][h3]bugfixes:[/h3][p]- equivalent link ring animation wasn't playing properly[/p][p]- equivalent link ring played its sound even if no dice were affected[/p][p]- cupidie could affect dice in your hand[/p][p]- fixed various controller issues regarding menus[/p][p]- fixed various controller issues regarding cards[/p][p]- fixed various crashes involving reloading[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.267
notes.notes: [p]heyyyy how you been doing?! as I said before, I've been working SO hard on stuff for the full game, buut I also squashed some bugs and made some QoL changes along the way that I felt were worth including in the demo, so here they are! hope you enjoy ;)[/p][p][/p][h3]changes:[/h3][p]- incubus die area increased to be the same as cupid and vampire[/p][p]- renamed ''face multiplier'' to stamp multiplier (makes more sense and is less confusing for new players)[/p][p]- added stamp multiplier keyword[/p][p]- reworded incubus die description to clarify that the value it gets by eating other dice IS its face value[/p][p]- changed the eternal enchantment description to also include exhausted dice, since it also negates that effect[/p][p]- cursed ring now takes 0 into account, meaning it will multiply everything by 0 if you roll a die with a 0[/p][p]- reworked the function that controls dice per turn and dice drawing, should be more consistent overall, always drawing your dice per turn if possible not mattering the situation[/p][p]- enchant card now won't give you the same enchantment a die already has[/p][p]- when rolling all your dice in the last roll at face 3, it now builds speed as you roll them, making it significantly faster with a big sized bag[/p][p]- changed how hands are saved internally to reduce the save file size (shouldn't affect anything really) [/p][p][/p][h3]fixes:[/h3][p]- bags bigger than 99 dice started behaving weird[/p][p]- selling blackring or noble ring mid round didn't reset your hand size[/p][p]- sometimes the game wouldn't draw a die you just rolled even if you hadn't met your dice per turn limit yet[/p][p]- enchanted and/or charged dice weren't properly hidden when using Blackring[/p][p]- enchanting already selected dice with laconism sometimes caused some problems[/p][p]- enchantments didn't show during trade events[/p][p]- gilded developer ring didn't work properly with dice rolled midroll[/p][p]- dice ice effect didn't carry over between rounds properly[/p][p]- dice rolled mid roll didn't display their extra value properly while fighting against The Cautious[/p][p]- pandora's box effect also affected anchors in your hand for some reason[/p][p]- while using a controller, you couldn't select cards on the map[/p][p]- end of round reward would crash if you reloaded the run while choosing golden stamps from a boss[/p][p]- hand selector sprite in the end of round reward disappeared if reloading the run during that screen[/p][p]- added an exception handler in the main menu to prevent crashes if your run save was corrupted (it will still be corrupted ofc, but previously the game wouldn't even let you launch and start another one)[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.266
notes.notes: [p]back at it with a new QoL patch! lots of small things to see here.[/p][p]as I said before, I'm going to slow down on updates for now so I can focus on actually working on new stuff for the full game, I'm really excited to show you what I have in store for you guys, see you soon :)[/p][p][/p][h3]changes:[/h3][p]- Bottle of Caps now gives between 1 and 15 Bottlecaps when destroyed[/p][p]- new animation for when the Bottle of Caps is destroyed[/p][p]- you can now hold R to restart a run[/p][p]- introduced the keyword "exhaust" for dice that disappear until the end of round when rolled or when a certain condition is met (ivory die, isaac's die), just to clean up descriptions and make everything more consistent[/p][p]- added "ghost die" as a keyword to the info menu[/p][p]- you can now press right click, escape key or b button on a controller to cancel an active ring's effect during a roll[/p][p]- gilded Lucky Ring now works as intended (gives 2 rerolls every reward selection) [/p][p]- tweaked a bit the face multiplier sound effect to make it less annoying on the ears[/p][p]- changed the "can't use here" text that appears when using a card in an incorrect place to "can't use right now"[/p][p]- the game won't be saved if you exit during starter pack selection (as it caused some problems and was pointless anyways lol) [/p][p][/p][h3]bugfixes:[/h3][p]- fixed a memory leak that happened when applying several effects to the same die in a very short period of time[/p][p]- The Hermit boss made Electric die's area bigger than intended[/p][p]- The Hollow boss would give you a Hollow die right upon entering the room [/p][p]- ghost dice would become permanent when saving and reloading[/p][p]- dice on the main menu could be clicked through the game's logo[/p][p]- fixed a crash when using controller on the changelog menu[/p][p]- isaac's die didn't work on unbalanced die[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.265
notes.notes: [p]sooooo after yesterday's big update to the internal number system, a lot of issues were found as I was expecting, so here comes a patch fixing those plus a bunch of other stuff![/p][p]I also finally fully implemented the saving and loading system, you can now save and exit while in shops with no problem, so no more save-scumming![/p][p]also, I've been thinking of a way to nerf the rubik + electric die combo without directly nerfing either of them, and I think I came up with a fantastic solution! the combo is still there and it's still amazing, but you probably won't be getting to NaNeinf so easily, which was my only goal, you can read more about it below :)[/p][p]anyways, happy gambling![/p][p][/p][h3]general changes:[/h3][p]- you can now save and quit at almost any point in the game (even during end of round rewards, shops, etc) save-scumming is gone![/p][p]- during specific events where saving and exiting isn't intended (like chests or magic rooms), ''save and quit'' text in the settings menu will be greyed out and you won't be able to click it[/p][p]- tweaked a bit how scientific notation displays numbers to be more accurate[/p][p]- added a slight animation for when a die is deactivated by a boss[/p][p]- dice that disappear until the end of round (ivory die, isaac die when rolling a 5) now don't do it if they have the eternal enchantment[/p][p][/p][h3]balance changes:[/h3][p]- piggydie lowered from 3 to 2 charges [/p][p]- electric die's area range now decreases in relation to how many dice are on the table (more dice = less range), however, the default size is bigger than before[/p][p]- electric die no longer gives a charge to charged dice (yes, it did before)[/p][p]- reworked how the physics on the pieces from rubik's cube work to make them more consistent[/p][p][/p][h3]fixes:[/h3][p]- there were no rewards in face 3 (how did I miss this lol)[/p][p]- deactivated enchanted dice didn't show their X visually[/p][p]- you could lose when scoring NaNeinf[/p][p]- scientific notation didn't work[/p][p]- granite die with echo didn't work[/p][p]- lucky block didn't work when transforming into certain dice that leave stuff on the table like paper die[/p][p]- discarded lucky blocks would stay transformed even when back in your bag[/p][p]- big score animation would always play when loading a run where you had a lot of pips[/p][p]- when reloading a run on the map you would sometimes lose pips[/p][p]- when using a controller, opening a pack would sometimes make an item un-selectable[/p][p]- you couldn't see your dice when on the starter pack screen[/p][p]- gilded rings didn't display properly in single ring reward room[/p][p]- you could reach -1 rolls by clicking super fast on the roll button[/p][p]- fixed a rare crash where if you had save data from the first demo from february 2025 the game would crash upon starting[/p]

notes.title: 0.264 (Performance Update)
notes.notes: [p]yep! you’re reading correctly! the days of waiting 10 minutes for a roll to calculate are over! (for the most part at least) I reworked how big numbers work internally and everything should be a LOT smoother, however, this may cause very BIG numbers to behave weird, so keep in mind this will probably be fine tuned as you guys start discovering weird stuff! Also, your records should be mostly intact, I made sure everything is converted correctly![/p][p]I also fixed a good bunch of bad bugs, hope you enjoy! :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/31653c606c6023e9848dabbd939d312ce9378c30.gif"][/img][/p][h2]changes:[/h2][p]- updated big number system. lag should be almost completely gone now, but stuff may behave weird when scoring crazy high, let me know if you encounter anything![/p][p]- developer ring now also affects dice rolled mid roll (bottle of caps, etc)[/p][p]- you can now navigate through the changelog menu using a controller[/p][p]- made rare and legendary dice a bit less common overall[/p][p][/p][h2]fixes: [/h2][p]- a button on the map could be selected even when not visible while using a controller[/p][p]- a text in rubik cube was yellow instead of blue[/p][p]- fixed a crash involving ice die + reroll ring + equity ring[/p][p]- some rings wouldn’t activate first round if taken from a starter pack[/p][p]- some rings would stay gilded between runs if you got them gilded once[/p][p]- some sounds still played even with sound effect volume at 0[/p][p]- deactivated dice would reactivate when reloading the game[/p][p]- consolation prize had a pointless ‘’currently:’’ text in its description[/p][p]- using a card on a dice would also automatically select it[/p][p]- you couldn’t access the discord button on the main menu with a controller[/p][p]- fixed controller behaving weird when pressing B while in the main menu[/p][p]- if on controller, selling a card with a pack opened also closed the pack[/p]

notes.title: Thanks for 10k wishlists! (2025 Roadmap & Recap)
notes.notes:
[p]First of all, I can't thank you guys enough for making Dice A Million reach the insane number of 10k (now 11k!) wishlists, it is absolutely mind-blowing to me. These past few weeks have been crazy![/p][p]So, some of you may know from the 1st demo back in February that I used to do monthly development updates (tho I only did two to be fair lol), and they slowed down mostly because I was finishing this new demo and wanted to release it asap. Anyways, since it's been almost a month since the 2nd demo came out, development posts are back baby! There's a lot to talk about, present, near future and far future, so let's get rolling![/p][p][/p][h1]DEMO 2 LAUNCH RECAP[/h1][p]As I've said, this launch went far better than what I could have ever imagined! A lot of new people came in and we're forming a really nice community over on the discord server, so that's awesome! I also wanted to thank everyone that made videos covering the game on Youtube, I try to watch everything but it's becoming too much, and that's a good sign I for sure!
Also, as you know I've been pushing some balance and QoL updates, as well as patching out any issue you may find, which brings me to the next point![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/624b0e3eea69ea10b16e5aec1258dd3db164ec42.png"][/img][/p][h1]FUTURE DEMO UPDATES[/h1][p]I sorted out mostly everything I wanted in the demo with the addition of starter packs, the changes to extra value, etc, and I'm already slowly getting back into working on features for the full release. but there's still some things I wanted to address.[/p][p][/p][h3]PERFORMANCE ISSUES[/h3][p]As the weeks passed by you guys started discovering some broken combos, and I mean broken in every single way. I'm aware that performance when rolling absurdly high numbers (like ~e100) is lacking and the game can become very laggy if there's a lot of dice on screen. I 100% know where the issue comes from, and I won't be explaining it here in detail but to summarize, it's basically a problem caused by a system I implemented to make big numbers as precise as possible, which they aren't 100% precise in computers by default (I also didn't know this when starting developing this game lol). I'm already working on a patch compromising precision for performance (which is preferred in almost every scenario), which will probably be ready in a couple of days, I'll let you guys know on how it's going, but here's a little teaser :)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/31653c606c6023e9848dabbd939d312ce9378c30.gif"][/img][/p][h3]BALANCE ISSUES[/h3][p]The other major complaint with the game right now is that there's basically one way to break it, and yes I'm completely aware. Some suggested making multipliers additive instead of multiplicative for the most part, and that's something I've thought of from the beginning but decided against. I'll think about it tho, as there's clearly a gap between multipliers and other strategies in the game. That being said, there's a lot of dice/rings that aren't present in the demo that make other strats a lot more viable, take a look at Mahjong Tile for example![/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/8e8164540979ebbb83f89bfdbf0fb10f2954ab2a.png"][/img][/p][p]so yeah this is my next point of focus after the balance issues are fixed, thank you guys for always leaving your feedback, I hear you loud and clear :)[/p][p] [/p][h1]FUTURE[/h1][p]So, after that's done, what happens? Well, I can't confirm at the moment, but the demo will probably be participating in Steam's October Next Fest, with a small content update dropping with it. Don't expect a ton since that will already be close to the game's release, and I feel like the demo already has what it needs, but it'll be a nice treat for sure![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/81bfd676f1bd0e5999522beb13c2a12eb4f26e7e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]GAME RELEASE[/h3][p]As I've stated before, the game will most likely release on late 2025 / early 2026, this is of course bound to change, but we're going at a great pace! Most of the pieces I want in the full release are already in place, so don't think that only the content in the demo is what I've done, far from it. Just that the \[REDACTED] needs some reworking, and I need to add one last \[REDACTED], oh and also if I have the time I'd like to add some \[REDACTED]. So yeah, not a whole lot really! :) I'm spending time in balancing and updating basic stuff right now, cause that's the most time consuming thing that it's still left to do.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/ef45c4a4d6d37970d5a8fc85e8e0404688167b3e.gif"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now!! I'm super excited to finally be able to show you what I've been cooking all this time, the game goes MUCH deeper than what it seems from the demo, I assure you that :) Also, be sure to join our [url="https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg"]discord server[/url] to stay in touch![/p][p]Anyways, til next time![/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.263 (Balance Update)
notes.notes: [p]today I got a pretty beefy balance update! these changes aim to make more different strategies viable, so hope you like the buffs and aren't too mad about the few nerfs! as always, let me know what you think :)[/p][p]I also think I fixed that one weird bug when alt-tabbing while in fullscreen, let me know if it works correctly now. anyways, let's get rolling![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/9b0f2214790ea79a253cf2d567e9f8027a39f5a6.gif"][/img][/p][h3]balance changes:[/h3][p]- rings that give pips (like asteroid ring, wedding ring) are now affected by all-table multipliers like glass die or megadie[/p][p]- wedding ring now has a minimum value of 1[/p][p]- consolation prize ring now takes into account dice spawned mid-roll like copies or caps from the bottle[/p][p]- dada die buffed from 2x to 3x multiplier[/p][p]- bottle of caps buffed from 1-10 to 1-15 (this also makes it so it breaks at 15 now, making it more difficult to happen)[/p][p]- jacks are now affected by dice spawned mid-roll[/p][p]- mirror cube nerfed from 3 to 4 charges[/p][p]- rubik's cube nerfed from 9 to 6 pieces[/p][p]- vampire die now multiplies only by the highest face it discarded[/p][p]- reduced vampire die area range[/p][p]- ''The Hermit'' boss now reduces area effects even more, and also makes it so charged dice can't gain any charges[/p][p][/p][h3]other changes:[/h3][p]- starter packs won't contain legendary dice nor legendary rings anymore[/p][p]- asteroid ring has a new animation[/p][p]- added gilded rings to the enchantments tab in the collection[/p][p]- added some visual details to the enchantments tab in the collection [/p][p]- updated bottle of caps sprite to make its number more visible[/p][p]- added dates to the changelog[/p][p][/p][h3]fixes:[/h3][p]- finally fixed the fullscreen bug that sometimes makes tha game window unreponsive when alt-tabbing, as a side-effect I had to remove the true fullscreen option, so now it's just borderless. It shouldn't affect anything really but of course some special setups could be, so let me know if it does for you![/p][p]- you could hold the skip to boss button while the next round animation was playing in the map[/p][p]- fixed a crash involving reroll ring + equity ring + ice die[/p][p]- the discount from gilded bling bling ring displayed incorrectly in the deck stats menu[/p][p]- fixed a small visual glitch with rings in the collection[/p][p]- enchantments weren't visible in starter packs[/p][p]- score bubble animation wasn't playing properly on rings that give score[/p][p]- dice with face 0 also contributed to asteroid ring[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.262.2
notes.notes: [p]quick patch fixing that one crash that people have been getting recently and also some other pretty old minor bugs! thank you all for the love recently <3[/p][p][/p][h3]fixes:[/h3][p]- fixed a rare crash regarding events (thank you all for all the help in figuring this one out!)[/p][p]- some dice rolled mid roll sometimes displayed their value higher than they should[/p][p]- fixed "null" dice appearing when combining fractal ring + time die[/p][p]- paper die note wasn't triggering at the right time[/p][p]- fixed developer/ascendant arrow graphic being black instead of yellow[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.262 (Starter Pack Update!)
notes.notes: [p]oh boy this is a big one! this update basically focused on making a smoother experience both for experienced and new players. there's a lot to unpack here, so let's get rolling![/p][p][/p][h3]new features:[/h3][p]- added starter packs. when starting a new run you will now be able to select a random booster pack before round 1 (although some like rare dice and rings are banned), to kickstart your run and make the beginning a little bit easier. this is something I thought a LOT about, and decided to stick with it because the game being too hard is one of its major criticisms right now.  I know some of you already know the game back to back and this is may seem pointless or unnecessary to you, so keep in mind two things: 1. I added a skip button for those of you that want to make the game harder on yourself, 2. the full game will include "ascension" levels that are MUCH harder than the base game, so the base difficulty being just a bit easier I think makes a lot of sense. as always I'm open to feedback, and especially with this, so let me know your thoughts :)[/p][p][/p][p]- added info menu, hover and hold shift over an item with any keywords (like face, extra value, destroy, etc) in its description to show in-depth explanations. meant to make crystal clear how some mechanics work and so new players can make better decisions[/p][p][/p][p]- added a button in the map to skip straight to the Face Boss. this only appears whenever you meet a certain threshold of score within the face, that being 1,500 for F1, 25k for F2 and 500k for F3. this is intended for speeding up runs that are already "won" and where you don't feel like trying to get a better build, since those always end up with you wasting all of your rolls in order to advance quicker anyways[/p][p][/p][p]- you can now view area range as well as the new info menu in end of round rewards[/p][p][/p][h3]changes:[/h3][p]- cupidie area range reduced to make it more viable[/p][p]- when rolling the dice on the map you can now more clearly see which dice matched the faces you were asked for[/p][p]- granite die now has a face animation[/p][p]- added a little tooltip in magic rooms to clarify which enchanment your dice already have (if it has one)[/p][p]- bottle of caps with "eternal" enchanment now won't break nor give you the bottlecaps when rolling a 10[/p][p]- smiley face ring buffed from +6 to +8 extra value[/p][p][/p][h3]fixes:[/h3][p]- beating a boss with an unlock on face 3 wouldn't give you the achievement[/p][p]- fixed some stuff not unlocking if you had tutorials disabled[/p][p]- developer ring turned 1s into 20 instead of 10[/p][p]- fully charged enchanted dice wouldn't appear with their usual green color tint[/p]

notes.title: DEMO Patch 0.261
notes.notes: [p]I'm back at it with another patch! this is mostly to fix some minor issues you've been having. thanks for reporting every crash, it really helps a ton :) Be sure to join our discord server to stay up to date and send me any issue you may find![/p][p]The next update will focus on adding more QoL features that will make your dice rolling better ;)[/p][p][/p][p]changes:[/p][p]- face 3 boss now doesn't give you rewards after beating it (since it's pointless in the demo)[/p][p][/p][p]new animations:[/p][p]- decimal die, cursed ring, third eye ring[/p][p][/p][p]fixes:[/p][p]- fixed some UI crashes when clicking menus while a map animation was playing[/p][p]- dice from your hand would disappear when rolling if you had more than 3 rows[/p][p]- fully charged dice were visible during The Blackout boss[/p][p]- casino die didn't work with equity ring[/p][p]- fixed more issues related to equity ring and isaac's die[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 0.260 (Thanks for 5,000 wishlists!)
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!! First of all, thank yall so so much for the 5,000 wishlists on steam! it is a mindblowing number for me tbh, keeps me going! :) Also, the DEMO has a dedicated page on Steam now, wohoo! this basically means you can now leave reviews, so go do it if you haven't already, so we can trick Steam's algorithm into making more people addicted to dice...! in other news, this is the first patch to get an in-game changelog so, hello everyone, I'm inside my game![/p][p]anyways, I've been working on a pretty beefy patch these past few days, so let's get the dice rolling[/p][p]
[/p][h3]EXTRA VALUE CHANGES:[/h3][p]- extra value added on the table while a roll is going is now also added to the current score of that die. this effectively buffs everything that gives EV on table like bandaid, d8, d10, d7, etc, but also makes the mechanic a bit more clear to understand for new players, lmk what you think! I also nerfed some dice/rings related to EV to match with this new approach as they would be too broken in their current state (tho they're all really buffs at the end of the day, given how the system works now, so don't worry too much about them)[/p][p]- bandaid ring nerfed from +3 to +2 extra value[/p][p]- paper die nerfed from +10 to +5 extra value[/p][p]- suit die's diamond face nerfed from +12 to +6 extra value[/p][p]- smiley medal nerfed from +10 to +6 extra value[/p][p]- cosmic die no longer gives +42 extra value when rolling a 42 (just the 42x mult) [/p][p]- ascendant die gets its extra value AFTER the score has been given, so essentially works the same as before, as the change would make a busted die even MORE busted lol (actually it IS a buff since it now takes into account stamp mults, whereas it didn't before)[/p][p]
[/p][h3]QoL:[/h3][p]- you can now hold your mouse over dice to select them faster [/p][p]- fully charged dice color tint is now lime green instead of yellow, for consistency sake[/p][p]- updated ''die of dice'' description to include its possible outcomes[/p][p]- new option for disabling screen shake in the settings menu[/p][p]- new option for disabling tutorials in the settings menu[/p][p]- added ingame changelog [/p][p]- background completely stops now if you turn speed all the way down to 0%[/p][p]- shops now display how much will the next map roll cost if there are any rewards[/p][p]- ''The Cautious'' boss makes extra value display as negative now, so you don't forget what it does ;)[/p][p]
[/p][h3]OTHER CHANGES:[/h3][p]- the ''deck'' is now called ''dice bag'' everywhere, just to be consistent[/p][p]- added a small animation for when the dice score bubble pops up[/p][p]- ''Area ring'' is now called ''Aura ring''. guess it did some aurafarming[/p][p]- updated some descriptions [/p][p]- removed extra value and enchantment tutorials, to speed up new players experiences[/p][p]
[/p][h3]NEW ANIMATIONS:[/h3][p]- bandaid ring, ascendant die, equivalent link[/p][p]
[/p][h3]BUGFIXES:[/h3][p]- fixed a visual bug when using a reroll card on a ring offer[/p][p]- fixed small map visual bug[/p][p]- paper die and fire die wouldn't activate with the loyalty effect[/p][p]- fixed game freezing when rolling isaac's die + equity ring[/p][p]- dice on fire didn't display their animation properly (technically a new animation but it was always intended to happen lol)[/p][p]- hand squiggle animations weren't playing during some events[/p]

notes.title: DEMO 2 IS OUT!
notes.notes: [p]Yes!!!! That’s what I’ve said!!!!! I’m shaking very violently!!!!!!! I'm really happy to announce that Dice a Million's 2nd DEMO is out now!!!! There's a LOT new to see here, I'll explain most of the things in this post, but essentially, apart from new dice, rings, and all of that, you'll notice the game feels super fresh because of all the new features and visual revamps, I’m sure you’ll enjoy it… OK I got no time to explain anything else, so let's get to the POINT! (or the pip whatever you wanna call it)[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ghPp-TxhCrk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]DICE A MILLION HAS A PUBLISHER?![/h1][p]Oh boy, that's right! I'm so excited to announce that I'll be working with [url="https://x.com/2_left_thumbs"]2 Left Thumbs[/url] to help me out with marketing, publishing, and all that stuff that doesn't involve the game itself! To celebrate, please look at this amazing new logo + key art that we got done by the amazing [url="https://x.com/octigone"]Octigone[/url]! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/93dc91a8c4e4309157d3f2c0a1e7a176f0e7a386.png"][/img][/p][p]To clarify, this won't have much impact on the game itself whatsoever (apart from feedback and improvements they might suggest :)), I'll still be in control and head of development as much as before. This collaboration will mostly ensure that the marketing side of things is handled by a competent person (which clearly I'm NOT) and I get to focus all my attention on DICE![/p][p][/p][h1]THE MAP[/h1][p]Last time I talked about a feature I was working on revamping and wasn't ready to be shared yet. Well, take a look at the new map!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/ae41811fc1a3392740975cc2a0977d22b4575706.png"][/img][/p][p]I always wanted to include some kind of branching path system in Dice A Million, but I wanted to do something different than your typical “choose between 3 paths” system. After a lot of reworking and trying out multiple systems, this iteration felt the most right to me. You still advance in a straight line to the boss, just like before. Remember those chests that could randomly appear after finishing a round? Well now those are treated as that round’s “special reward”, and as you can see, they’re visible on the map. However, you can of course try to opt for something better than that good old dusty chest. Here’s where the branching paths come into place.[/p][p]If you’re feeling confident in your deck, you can bet a small amount of pips to try and roll YOUR dice and get the faces that these special rewards are asking for.[/p][p]I tried to make sure this system added a new interesting strategic component, but still is quick, easy to understand, and ensures the focus of the game keeps being on rolling dice as usual. I’m sure you’ll like it :)[/p][p][/p][h1]VISUAL OVERHAUL[/h1][p]I’ve been also working on adding a lot of little cool custom animations for most of the effects in the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/394986052d90f568ed4719c0907c7580a5474e30.png"][/img][/p][p]This, apart from looking pretty sick, will ensure it’s easier to read everything that happens on the board.[/p][p]Also as you may have noticed, there’s a new background!! This will be the new default background for now, but the old one isn’t gone forever. You are be able to change them in game, and… well, you’ll see what I have in mind![/p][p][/p][h1]COLLECTION REWORK[/h1][p]Something I've been hiding for a while is a complete rework of the collection menu!! This comes with new tabs for bosses and enchantments, as well as a stats system, so you can keep track of how many times you roll a dice or take a ring. Finally, you'll be able to brag to your friends about your addiction to taking Bottle of Caps every single time!!!![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/61ad7d61d73d0103509984ea4af455a377c157ca.png"][/img][/p][p]More features like different sorting methods and graphs are in development, I got you covered, my statistics nerds ;)[/p][p][/p][h1]AND... FULL GAME RELEASE????!!!!![/h1][p]OKAY let’s calm down. The game isn’t quite ready yet, there’s still a lot to do and a lot of walls to bang my head against, buuuut we’re definitely getting closer! Apart from getting everything for the new demo set up, these months I also focused on narrowing down the scope of the game and what exactly I want in the 1.0 release. I think I can confidently say that the game will come out in [b]late 2025 / early 2026\[[/b]. There will be a lot of hands, difficulty levels, achievements, objectives to work towards, dice, rings, and of course, [i]tons of secrets[/i].[/p][p]Also!! I wanted to thank Graeme from 2LT for all the help and feedback he’s been giving me! He’s basically making sure the dice-based gambling meal I’m cooking is in perfect state for you guys.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, that's all for now! Be sure to join the [url="https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg"]official discord server[/url] to keep up with updates and let me know of any bugs you find!![/p][p][/p][p]Here's the full changelog, happy gambling!![/p][p][/p][h2]CHANGELOG:[/h2][p][/p][p]New dice:[/p][p]- Translucid D6, Echo Cube, Casino Die, Electric Die, Anchor, Pandora's Box, Ivory Die, Granite Die, Porcelain Figurine, Pigdie, Mirror Cube[/p][p][/p][p]New rings:[/p][p]- Blackring, Cell Ring, Fishbone Charm, Mini-AWP, Smiley Medal, Stamp Ring, Platinum Ring, Electric Ring, Radiowave[/p][p][/p][p]New cards:[/p][p]- Charge, Reward[/p][p][/p][p]New bosses:[/p][p]- The Blackout, The Cautious[/p][p][/p][p]New features:[/p][p]- reworked map system, you can now roll your dice to get some special after round rewards, as well as use cards while in the map screen[/p][p]- new stamp system. upgrade face numbers globally throughout your run. silver ones give you +0.2 mult and golden ones give you +0.5 mult[/p][p]- added new booster packs to the shop (enchanted dice pack & stamp pack)[/p][p]- beating a boss now gives its usual rare dice reward plus a new golden stamp[/p][p]- skipping end of round rewards now gives you pips[/p][p]- added gilded rings (essentially rings with "echo" enchantment)[/p][p]- added new parity check indicator (toggleable in settings). allows you to easily tell wether your roll is all odd, even, or mixed[/p][p]- added several new unique animations and sound effects for most of the dice/rings in the game, making everything more stylish and also hopefully improving readability[/p][p]- added new tabs and statistics to the collection menu[/p][p]- new "charges" system used by a couple of dice. everytime you roll one of these a charge is added. their effect will only be triggered once they're rolled while fully charged, using up their charges[/p][p]- added red dice rooms. think of these as your "elites" or "minibosses". harder regular rounds that will always reward you with rare dice selections. unlocked by beating the game at least once.[/p][p]- removed the permanent shop ring per face, replaced with another booster pack slot. there's now plenty of new ways to obtain rings with the new map system, so this felt pointless[/p][p][/p][p]Changes:[/p][p]- changed how big numbers work internally, should be more stable in general, this is something a bit experimental I wanted to test with you guys. this also resets your old score records, but isn't it more fun starting fresh?[/p][p]- changed the default background, the old one is still accesible through the settings menu[/p][p]- selling cards now gives you more pips based on which face you currently are (F1 -> 5, F2 -> 50, F3 -> 500)[/p][p]- odd of dice / even of dice now discard themselves if their requirements aren't met, instead of changing their value to 0. this allows you to use them with the eternal enchantment. also updated their sprites[/p][p]- bandaid ring nerfed from +5 to +3 extra value[/p][p]- magnetic die physics reworked, plus now it gives +1 charge to charged dice[/p][p]- changed the name of "Multiplier Die" to "Carlos's Die"[/p][p]- updated 2-faced coin, lucky block and ice die sprites[/p][p]- ice die and fire die are now unlocked by beating their respective bosses (if you've played the old demo before you already have them unlocked)[/p][p]- ancient die now works with the new charge system, making it more viable (also technically buffed since it now requires 8 rolls, instead of 10)[/p][p]- updated fire die sprite and buffed from 20-25 to 30-35[/p][p]- vampire die now discards dice instead of changing their value to 0 (again, makes the eternal enchantment much more useful)[/p][p]- pocket pencil is now worth 3 instead of 0, and also buffed its mult from 3X to 4X[/p][p]- incubus die now gains "base value" instead of extra value that doesn't disappear. this makes everything more consistent, and allows it to gain extra value on top of its base, but also makes it so the base only goes up whenever it eats other dice, which wsa always its intended use[/p][p]- unbalanced die is now worth 51 on its highest face instead of 50, ensuring it's always odd[/p][p]- magic ring nerfed from 3X to 2X[/p][p]- large number dice (d100, d666, piñata) now display their face when rolled[/p][p]- standard dice packs on the shop now contain at least uncommon dice[/p][p]- added titles to end-of-round rewards to show what type of reward you're getting[/p][p]- updated several item descriptions to be more clear[/p][p]- added several UI and game animations[/p]

notes.title: April Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all thank you so much for 1,500 wishlists! I've been pretty silent as of recently as there's been a lot of movement behind the curtains, so achieving that number with almost no marketing efforts is honestly amazing. Thank you all!
As I promised last time, I wanted to try and make huge monthly posts talking about development and what I've been doing, and welp there's certainly a lot to talk this time around, so let's get rolling...! [i](get it... rolling...)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/bbb8650c4b29f268c17e41ab72c1f03806d5542f.gif[/img]

[h1]WHAT I'VE BEEN DOING[/h1]

Sooo this past month has been a beefy one. After the success of the demo, I kept working on [REDACTED] as I said last time. But I started prototyping some new core mechanics for the game, and some ended up sticking...! (get it cause they're stamps!)

[h2]STAMPS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/a05ff84fee0b46d2cebfca125764d3103d7eb0af.gif[/img]

Stamps are a new major mechanic I'm introducing, and to summarize, they're my way to make Dice A Million scale infinitely.
If you've ever had a crazy strong run in the DEMO where you have the exact build you want, you probably noticed how it feels like nothing ever matters anymore and you have hit a ceiling. That's something that doesn't happen that much in other roguelikes and I came to the conclusion that it was because this game didn't have something that scaled infinitely, like stats in The Binding Of Isaac, relics in Slay the Spire, or planet cards in Balatro, if you've played any of those games, you'll know what I'm talking about.

So what do these stamps do? Good question. They [b]raise your global multiplier for their respective face[/b]. This means, if you "level up" your 2 by taking a lot of stamps, every die with a 2 on its face will be multiplied at the end of the chain of dice & ring effects, ensuring they're useful both in early and it late game. And of course, a bunch of synergyes involving new dice and rings will be added to play around with this mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/ad04c2a3d94618ffc98b6fe7870e409cbbde16fe.png[/img]

And what about dice with faces greater than 6? Great question [i](this guy's making a lot of questions...)[/i] I won't reveal it for now but I do have a solution for those, ensuring this mechanic is core to the game and used by every type of die!
Poor D666, don't worry honey, we haven't forgotten about you.

[h2]NEW DICE & RINGS[/h2]

Of course, I've been also working on a lot of new dice & rings! Currently the demo has 57 dice and 36 rings. And the total in the current build of the game is... 91 dice and 52 rings! (so almost double the content, wow!)
As I've said before, my goal for the full release is to have 100~ rings and [i]at least[/i] 150-200 dice.
I also want to make sure every single one of them has its place in the game and is unique in some way. So I'm carefully slowly designing and balancing them.

Here's a new favorite of mine, the Aquarium!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/38569ff64ec1c5ac6ceca76fe1999b8bd420076b.png[/img]

This one's really fun to play around with, and it can get pretty powerful with the right build. It's also one of the new set of dice that do their effect when they stay in hand, rather than when they're rolled, there will be more of these! [i]Also be careful when handling the Aquarium, as it is quite fragile...[/i]

And speaking of fish... oh look, here's a new ring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/11203fd0c3505e5f882e2f5ee7ccef0aff363887.png[/img]

This one's for the keepers, for you people that keep that precious glass die in your hand until the end of the round to give an all out! For every turn that dice stay in your hand with this ring, they'll become more powerful! [i](I promise this is the last fish themed one)[/i]

[h2]OTHER FEATURES[/h2]
I've been also working on new QoL features, new hands and other major stuff, but I'll save that for next time!

Oh and apart from all of this, I've been finishing up work on [REDACTED] and ready to get to work on the next [REDACTED]. I'm sure you'll enjoy it :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/0fc68429df0891dc3c4c052f891ae485790191d5.png[/img]

[h2]PERFORMANCE ISSUES[/h2]

Lastly, I wanted to make a quick note about performance, since I noticed the game does slow down a fair bit on lower end computers. From what I could test, the cause seems to be the CRT filter. Which is reassuring in a way, but probably has no quick solution I can push to the demo right now. I'm looking for a way to optimize the shader and make it run more smoothly, but in the meantime, if you're experiencing this issue, you can just turn off the filter in the settings menu and it should run a lot better, again, let me know!

[h1]WHAT'S BEEN HAPPENING[/h1]

Apart from me working on the game, there's been a lot of movement behind the curtains, some stuff that I can't talk about yet, and some that I don't WANT to talk about yet. Trust me you'll see...

[h2]MODDING[/h2]
Soo, there's been some people interested in modding the DEMO as of lately! I just wanted to make clear that I fully support this and it's been amazing seeing what people might do with my duck-taped code [i](please modders don't judge me)[/i].
While I may not have the knowledge or the tools at the moment, feel free to shoot me a DM or a message on the [url=https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg]discord server[/url] in case I can help with something!

[h2]QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS AND QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS[/h2]

Speaking of the [url=https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg]discord server, (which you should totally join btw as we're about to hit 100 members)[/url] I asked people there if they had any questions regarding the game or me in general, so let's get to them!

[i]Q: Will cards receive a rework with rarities?[/i]
A: Cards function a bit different than other items like dice & rings, they're meant to be something you can rely on to fight against the natural RNG that dice have. For that reason, I didn't want to make a ton of them, just so it's easier to find the one you need. That being said, I do have plans of adding at least a couple of new ones to the standard set, and THEN make a separate card set, that will have cards that are more powerful or more weird in general. The goal is to make these separate pools, so you can still rely on getting your good old standard cards, but also get some cool new ones in some other way.

[i]Q: If you could remove/overhaul a system in the game, which one?[/i]
A: That's something I can do, cause I'm the developer, duh.
The answer is very clear in my mind, and I wanted to talk about it in this post since it's something I've been working on recently, buuuut it sitll needs a bit more time in the oven sadly, so I'll save it for next time. It involves reworking a pretty major mechanic, so I'm making sure it works properly and feels nice to play! (so far testers have liked it!)

[i]Q: What's your favorite flavor of icecream?[/i]
A: Coffee

[i]Q: Why is everyone saying silly?[/i]
A: I don't know. I seriously don't know. for the love of god please join the discord server and find out for yourself.



phew, that's all for today. see you next time! :D

notes.title: We hit 1,000 Wishlists on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello! First of all, I wanted to thank everyone that has tried out the demo of Dice A Million and has wishlisted the game, all the support lately has been mindblowing. I was expecting to maybe hit 1,000 wishlists by summer but the fact that we did it not even a month after the demo release is just something I definitely didn't see coming. ANYWAYS, enough talking about these numbers and let's talk about the numbers you like better... In celebration for the huge milestone I'm going to talk a bit about the development of the game and when to expect the full thing. so let's go!

[h1][b]DEMO OVERVIEW[/b][/h1]

So it's been almost a month since the demo launched, and it's been so cool seeing all of you reach crazy scores with amazing and thoughtful synergies. There's been a pretty active discord community [url=https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg](here's the link if you want to join us!)[/url] telling me some QoL stuff to improve the game and sending me bugs to fix. Some Youtubers and streamers also played the game on their channels, it's been a surreal experience watching people play and tinker with stuff I've made here in my bedroom, so wether you're a content creator, a normal player, or just someone who wishlisted the game, thank you. It's been giving me all the energy I need to make this game the best I can.
Also! I've seen some of you try to reach the 1M score objective at the Face 3 door. This is obviously meant to be an impossible roll that you'll be able to win in "another way" in the full game, buut since a lot of you are trying to do it, I'll most likely make it an achievement, as I think it's a fun secret challenge. You can try in the demo, but you won't get anything (just so you're not disappointed lol)

[h1][b]WHAT'S NEXT[/b][/h1]

In the meantime, I've been working on a lot of stuff for the full game, and boy I've been pretty busy. I've been working on new dice, rings, bosses and most importantly, I've been working on [REDACTED], one of the three main [REDACTED] that you'll see in the game. It's been so fun watching my playtesters experience this for the first time (they thought it was HARD >:D)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/ef45c4a4d6d37970d5a8fc85e8e0404688167b3e.gif[/img]

About dice quantity... the full game currently has 77 dice. They're a lot, yes, and I'm really close to the goal I had (which was 100). But I think I'm raising that bar by a lot. See the thing with Dice A Million is that given the nature of the game, you see a lot of different dice during a single run, compared to other roguelikes, where you see a lot less items, and that ofc makes it seem like there aren't that many. So for that reason and to add more variety, I'll probably make a lot more of them and try to aim for 200 at least, I've though maybe that would be too much of them (keep in mind most will be locked from the start), but I don't know we'll see.

Here's one I really like that I teased on the Discord server

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/cdce035faa49a68b95093ecad98442296e49ee08.png[/img]

Also I wanted to talk briefly about NaNeinf. You may have seen that word around if you've been active on the community or if you managed to get it yourself, but either way, that's basically an expression meaning "Not a Number to the power of infinity" that computers have for when you reach the highest number possible, which in this case is Xe308 (basically any number followed by 308 zeroes...) I've been looking for ways to raise this ceiling so you can get higher scores, and I think I've found a way. Don't take my word on this cause it may just not be possible, but we'll see.

[h1][b]WHEN[/b][/h1]

A lot of you asked me when the game's coming out and... the truth is I don't really know. I'm working A LOT to get it done by this year, which I'm 90% sure that will be the case (that 10% is cause you never know!), but I'm still not sure what the timeframe will be. What I CAN tell you is that I'm aiming to participate in this summer's Steam Next Fest, meaning I'd have an update for the demo. Still not sure what would that include but yeah definitely something. HOWEVER, there's a possibility that when summer comes I feel the game's still too far away from release, and in that case, I'd postpone it and participate in the following Next Fest during the winter. (Still would probably update the game during summer but with something smaller).
The thing is, I want this game to come out more than anyone in the world, so in the meantime, I'll try to be as transparent as I can with you guys :) This is all I can tell you for now on the topic of release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/19a92e8ce7dfe65fb0f4886de61a3eb7b769bf97.gif[/img]


So yeah that's all for now! Again, thanks for 1,000 wishlists and all the support recently. I think I'm gonna try and make these posts monthly to keep you guys updated. Make sure to follow me on my socials and join the discord community so you don't miss anything...!

[i]and... wait. what's that? can you hear that? aren't those footsteps, where are they coming from? walls seem unstable around here...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415352/0eb3ed4303ee7bbf69f4c17de6eb21532e6dd76c.gif[/img]

anyways... until next time! :D

notes.title: DEMO Patch Notes 0.136 (Balancing + LOTS of bugfixing)
notes.notes:
Heello, back with another patch! This time I focused on balancing and loads of bugfixing. This one's also the first I've done with an in-game pop-up. I've been doing a bunch of these patches, but Steam apparently doesn't show them in the demo feed for some reason, so I figured I'd include a notification in game so everyone can keep track of the changes!

And now for the sad news: today I bring a pretty big nerf. Say goodbye to the broken Ascendant Die. A lot of people noticed how insanely strong the Ascendant die + perennial combo was, making them reach even "infinite score" so so easy, so I finally decided to remove this. This combo has been known from the first time I added the die ofc, and I knew it was VERY STRONG. The reason I kept it in was because, at the time, I felt like the Ascendant die would be pretty weak by itself otherwise, but I don't think that's the case anymore though. I've seen people do crazy stuff with the Ascendant die even without the enchantment, but of course, taking a lot more effort, and that's exactly what I want. Some people on the Discord even started challenging themselves to reach insane scores WITHOUT the ascendant die, that's how busted it is lol
Sooo yeah hope you enjoy the rest of changes and bugfixes though!
Happy gambling!

NEW FEATURES:
- added a patch notes pop up for whenever you launch a new patch for the first time

CHANGES:
- Ascendant Die now ALWAYS loses its extra value after the round ends, even when enchanted
- The Tower ring is now Rare
- Green hand no longer starts with Hoarder Ring, but has an innate +2 drawn dice per turn
- Green hand now starts with 10 more D6's, making them a bit harder overall by bloating their deck
- Red hand now starts with 2 less Bottlecaps, making them stronger
- red chests now cost half of that round's objective, or 70% of your current score if you are above that. also clarified that red chests cost money and added a little confirmation hold button to avoid accidental openings
- auto-select button now takes extra value into account, as well as the laconism enchantment
- added a little indicator for already thrown dice when you have deja-vu ring

BUGFIXES:
- area range preview didn't work when using active rings mid-roll
- vampire die now properly displays shortened numbers
- fixed some spelling errors
- dumbbell description wasn't explained properly
- cancel button on some active rings wasn't displaying correctly
- fixed a visual bug involving cards
- dice with eternal enchantment could still be discarded through some methods
- dice enchantments weren't displaying when rewarded from a chest
- enchanted dice gotten from a dice pack cycled through faces super quick
- reroll card could be used in uninteded places
- "The Frost" boss would leave the frost effect for the next round you played after being defeated

notes.title: DEMO Patch Notes 0.135 (+Discord launch!)
notes.notes:
I'm back at it again fixing some nasty crashes! I've also decided to nerf a pretty busted combo with Sudokus and the Equity ring, sorry for breaking your dreams! (more info below)

Also, some exciting news! I noticed a lot of you were sending me your runs, ideas, bug reports and whatnot across all social media, so in order to keep everything more organized, I launched a Discord server! There you can chat with other players, give me suggestions, bug reports, or talk to me about anything! I also wanted to thank [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TerrariaSlime]Terrria Slime[/url] who's gonna help me a bit with moderation there <3
You can find an invite button in-game, and [url=https://discord.gg/Ah6vJn2Xfg]also here![/url]

Now for the actual patch notes

CHANGES:
- Sudoku now needs a die that ISN'T another Sudoku matching its face in order to trigger. In exchange, it now gives a 5x multiplier PER die matching its face. Meaning if you match faces with two other dice, Sudoku will now trigger twice, or thrice if you have three, and so on.
- Added Discord invite button on the main menu

BUGFIXES:
- fixed a crash with autoselect button that happened if you had less dice to select than your maximum hand size
- fixed a crash involving cursed ring and time die
- fixed a bug where if you sold or lost Equity ring, the effect would still last forever

notes.title: Demo Patch notes 0.134 (QoL + bugfixes)
notes.notes:
Hello! thank you so so much for the love on the demo so far, it's been amazing seeing the response! some of you gave me a few ideas on QoL features and I heard you loud and clear! on top of that, I also added a couple of dice from the full game to make some rarity tiers a bit more diverse. hope you enjoy <3

NEW DICE:
- Ice Die (Uncommon)
- Vampire Die (Rare)
- Cosmic Die (Legendary)

NEW FEATURES:
- dice with area effects now display their exact range by holding CTRL when hovered. dice that spawn other dice with area effects (like Fire Die or Paper Die) also display their range despite not having the effect themselves. this also takes into account any rings or effects you may have that would alter dice's range.
- added a new "auto select" button. you need to turn it on in settings in order for it to appear. it automatically selectes your higher rarity and/or higher value dice for the sake of convenience. it's made for those first few rounds where there isn't much thinking to do and you just go with the highest dice possible. keep in mind this is still largely untested so it might cause some bugs.
- dice spawned by others are now limited to 100. this probably won't affect the demo too much but in the full game there's some crazy dice that can roll copies of other ones, and with the right combo, you could get an almost infinite loop. for the good health of the game and your PC, this is now limited lol

also fixed a couple of bugs being the first one the nastiest of them all!
FIXED BUGS:
- dice would sometimes glitch out of the table
- shadows didn't display correctly in deck menu
- default volume was too loud
- intro screen could be quickly clicked on multiple times causing loud audio

phew, that's all for this patch!
as I've said I'm hard at work fixing any bugs you may encounter, so if you find any or wanna share any opinions, feel free to reach out to me via email (countlessnightsdev@gmail.com), twitter (@countlessn1ghts) or bluesky (@countlessnights) and I'll glady read you!
